title: EAU Guidelines on Urolithiasis
scope: Supports red-flag assessment and prompt pain relief in suspected renal colic, and urgent decompression assessment when urinary obstruction is infected.

title: EAU Guidelines on Urological Infections
scope: Supports recognising systemic urinary infection, addressing obstruction, and urgent multidisciplinary assessment of suspected Fournier gangrene.

title: EAU Paediatric Urology: Acute Scrotum
scope: Supports immediate specialist action for suspected testicular torsion and avoiding ultrasound-related delays in urgent treatment decisions.

title: NICE CG97: Lower urinary tract symptoms in men
scope: Supports prompt catheter drainage for acute urinary retention in men and attention to renal function in relevant retention presentations.

title: AUA Medical Student Curriculum: Urologic Emergencies
scope: Supports recognising acute urinary retention and gross haematuria with clot retention as presentations requiring prompt urological assessment.

title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign: Adult Guidelines
scope: Supports coordinated sepsis assessment and resuscitation with early evaluation of anatomical infection sources that require source control.

title: NICE CG50: Recognising and responding to deterioration
scope: Supports physiological monitoring, escalation triggered by observations or clinical concern, immediate response to emergencies and explicit reassessment plans.

title: NICE NG148: Acute kidney injury
scope: Supports assessing oliguria and creatinine changes, reviewing perioperative risks and medicines, and investigating or escalating suspected urinary obstruction.

title: EAU Urological Trauma: Urogenital trauma guidelines
scope: Supports concern for postoperative bladder injury when urinary output changes or urine leakage occurs, with specialist-directed investigation.

title: NICE NG253: Could this be sepsis?
scope: Supports suspecting sepsis in possible infection with changes in behaviour, circulation or respiration, and taking patient or family concerns into account.

title: EAU Bladder Cancer Guidelines: Disease management
scope: Supports postoperative ileus, urinary leakage and serious infection as complications of cystectomy and urinary diversion that warrant clinical assessment.

title: NICE NG158: Venous thromboembolic diseases
scope: Supports probability-based diagnostic assessment of suspected pulmonary embolism or deep vein thrombosis and consideration of renal, bleeding and postoperative factors.

title: NICE NG89: Reducing the risk of hospital-acquired VTE
scope: Supports assessing and reassessing VTE and bleeding risks in surgical patients, including those undergoing abdominal or urological surgery.
